verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills and workflow plugin for coding agents, and scheduling recurring workflows is a fair automation question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers interactive, session-scoped workflows: brainstorming, planning, subagent-driven execution and session-start skill triggering. Nothing documents cron-like, timed or recurring job scheduling; hours of autonomous work and session-start hooks are not scheduling.
